content.title: Bhad Bhabie Shares “Bad News” From Her Doctor Amid Cancer Journey
content.text: Bad baby is sharing unfortunate news about her cancer throughout the road onBhad Bhabie Shares “Bad News” From Her Doctor Amid Cancer Journey0 seconds of 1 minute, 0Volume 0%Bhad Bhabie Shares “Bad News” From Her Doctor Amid Cancer JourneyBhad Bhabie is opening up about her health. More than a year after the “Gucci Flip Flops” rapper shared her cancer diagnosis, she opened up about how her health is on the decline. “Bad news from my doctor yesterday,” Bhad Bhabie (born Danielle Bregoli) wrote on X Feb. 28, “god has the last say so not my cancer.” The Dr. Phil alum’s candid health update comes after sharing her diagnosis in November 2024 following online criticism of her body. "I'm sorry my cancer medicine made me loose [sic] weight,” she wrote on Instagram Stories at the time. "I’m slowly gaining it back. So, stop running with the worst narratives." E! News has previously reached out to Bhad Bhabie's rep for comment but didn’t hear back. Following her health update, Danielle’s mom Barbara Bregoli slammed internet trolls who said the “Bestie” rapper’s diagnosis was “karma.” “Let me say this, social media has become an app where people think they can come on here and say the most vile things,” Barbara said in a Mar. 1 Instagram video, “and think it’s funny because they’re hiding behind a screen.”“But to turn around and say someone who has cancer, that’s their karma, that’s a low form,” she added. “That’s the lowest form of anything. Babies don’t ask to get cancer, little children don’t ask to get cancer, the elderly don’t ask to get—nobody asks to get cancer.” She also warned online bullies of speaking ill on situations they’ve never experienced. “So, don’t come on here with your balls so mighty saying, ‘Oh, yeah that’s your karma,’ because it just might be yours,” she added. “Don’t ever say something about someone unless you’ve experienced it. Let me tell you something, play with me every day. Don’t come after my kid. Don’t come after my family.”Instagram/Bhad BhabiePreviously, Barbara also clapped back at critics claiming Danielle—who shares 23-month-old daughter Kali Love with ex Le Vaughn—was faking her ailment. "How dare you you?" Barbara said in a 2024 Instagram video addressing one of Bhad Bhabie's critics. "I pray to God that one of your children never gets cancer. I've had it twice. How dare you say my daughter's faking this, you vile piece of no good s--t." On Instagram Stories, she added of the allegations against her daughter, "My god these comments are beyond disgusting—but like I always say, GOD DONT LIKE UGLY!!" She continued, "Stop with the assumptions!!!" For a look at more stars who have been open about their cancer journeys, keep reading…Paul Archuleta/Getty ImagesColin EgglesfieldThe All My Children alum announced in January 2025 that he had been diagnosed with prostate cancer, his third cancer diagnosis throughout his life. Despite the devastating news, he announced (for the third time) in February 2025 he was cancer-free following successful surgery and treatments. “Remember, you’re not defined by any of your challenges," he wrote in his February 2025 Instagram update. "You’re grander than it all.
